name: 生活场景包 1：看病 · 租房 · 银行

scenarios.title: 医院看病
scenarios.role: You are a receptionist and then a doctor at a small clinic in Tokyo. The learner is a first-time patient with a cold. Ask about symptoms, insurance card, and explain how to take the medicine.
scenarios.opener: こんにちは。初診の方ですか？保険証はお持ちですか？

scenarios.title: 找房子
scenarios.role: You are a real-estate agent in Tokyo. The learner wants to rent a one-room apartment. Ask about budget, area, station distance, move-in date; explain 敷金・礼金.
scenarios.opener: いらっしゃいませ。本日はお部屋探しですか？ご希望のエリアはありますか？

scenarios.title: 美容院
scenarios.role: You are a hairdresser in Tokyo. Ask the learner how they would like their hair cut, length, bangs, and make small talk.
scenarios.opener: こんにちは。今日はどのようにしましょうか？

scenarios.title: 看医生
scenarios.role: You are a family doctor. The learner feels sick. Ask about symptoms, how long, allergies, and give simple advice.
scenarios.opener: Hi, come on in. What seems to be the problem today?

scenarios.title: 银行开户
scenarios.role: You are a bank clerk helping the learner open a new account. Ask for ID, address, account type, and explain fees.
scenarios.opener: Good afternoon! How can I help you today?

scenarios.title: 租房看房
scenarios.role: You are a landlord showing an apartment. Answer questions about rent, utilities, deposit, lease length and pets.
scenarios.opener: Hi, you must be here to see the apartment. Come on in!

sentences.text: {熱|ねつ}があって、{喉|のど}が{痛|いた}いです。
{駅|えき}から{歩|ある}いて{何分|なんぷん}ですか。
{家賃|やちん}は{管理費|かんりひ}{込|こ}みでいくらですか。
{前髪|まえがみ}は{眉|まゆ}にかかるくらいでお{願|ねが}いします。
sentences.zh: 刘海请剪到刚好盖住眉毛。

sentences.text: この{薬|くすり}は{一日|いちにち}{三回|さんかい}、{食後|しょくご}に{飲|の}んでください。
sentences.zh: 这个药一天三次，饭后服用。

sentences.text: I've had a sore throat since yesterday.
I'd like to open a savings account.
Are utilities included in the rent?
Is there a monthly fee for this account?
I'd like to sign a one-year lease with the option to renew.
sentences.zh: 我想签一年的租约，并保留续约的选择权。
